'''Baeshana''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Tarasin]] and a member of the [[Wyrd]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Witch/Legends|witch]] living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Tarasin]], Baeshana lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the final decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A member of the [[Wyrd]], Baeshana was trained in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the group and eventually was skilled enough to be considered a [[Witch/Legends|witch]]. During her time as a Wyrd sister, Baeshana employed a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] named [[Veshin]].<ref name="HTW" />

{{RPG}}
When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], a conflict between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Baeshana resided the village of the [[Zhadorii irstat]]. Residing in the camp's central tent, she was visit when the village was attacked by a band of mercenaries and freedom fighters known as the [[Heroes of Cularin]].<ref name="HTW" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Hunting the Wyrd]]'' the identity of the Wyrd sister and bodyguard that the player characters fight in the central hut varies, depending on player level. Upper-level players fight Baeshana and Veshin, but Mid-Level players fight [[Naelora]] and [[Kosaa]] instead, while High-Level players face [[Torunin]] and [[Savina]]. It is also possible for the players to avoid the hut, so the fight against Baeshana doesn't even have to take place.
